capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: gross 89 kWh for the same pack as the Equinox EV (Auto-data; InsideEVs calculated 89.0 kWh). Existing Blazer records hold 85 as gross.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: The Weekly Driver lists NCMA (NMC family with aluminium) for the 85 kWh 10-module Ultium pack; closest enum nmc.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: the Blazer EV 85 kWh pack is the same 10-module Ultium pack as the Equinox EV (The Weekly Driver). Usable 85 / gross 89 from Auto-data and InsideEVs for the Equinox pack; the Blazer bare "85 kWh" is read as usable. Not read for the Blazer itself. OWNER FLAG: existing Blazer records hold 85 as gross and 80 as usable.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: same 85 kWh 10-module Ultium pack as the Equinox EV (nominal 336 V per The Weekly Driver; either way a 400 V-class pack, as stored for the Equinox).
Estimated: same 85 kWh 10-module pack as the Equinox EV. InsideEVs: about 288 V nominal (80S 3P), more like a 300 V system, so 400 V class (not 800 V).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Chevrolet's battery-preconditioning quick-start guide and Charging App help text (chevrolet.com returns 403, so read only as a search excerpt) describe the car automatically preconditioning the battery when you route to a DC fast charger in Google Maps, and a manual Start under Next charge. Not read on a page for this exact model year; applied to this model line on the same Ultium software. UNVERIFIED, weakest for 2023-2024 cars.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: the page is a 2026 RS AWD window sticker (11.5 kW onboard charging module). Other sources say every Blazer EV configuration has the 11.5 kW module; no 19.2 kW option found.

Estimated: InsideEVs table lists 11.5 kW for LT/RS eAWD; Wikipedia 11.5 kW; The Charge Port 2027 up to 11.5 kW. A reseller (Enel X Way) and GMAuthority suggest an optional 19.2 kW on RS RWD/SS; Recharged and the 2026 RS AWD window sticker say 11.5 kW for all; NRCan lists no 19.2 kW Blazer.

dc_max_kw.notes: US dealer page: LT and RS (85 kWh) up to 150 kW; 190 kW is the 102 kWh SS. Same wording on a 2026 RS AWD window sticker (src-coughlin-2026-blazer-ev-rs-awd). Conflicts with the 190 kW already stored from thinkEV (which says 102 kWh for all trims; likely wrong for the 85 kWh pack).
Estimated: InsideEVs Blazer table (GM figures): LT/RS 85 kWh = 150 kW. Years on this powertrain: 2025.
